camera.motion: static (no pan/shake; static-deck phase correlation frame0 vs 25/49 identical)
camera.view: looking straight down (orthographic-like top view); x right, y down in image
camera.perspective: negligible in-plane; dog (on deck top) and ring (on water, slightly lower) are at slightly different heights - treat as one plane unless told otherwise

dog.description: black dog (only dark animal), seen from above, walking left->right along the deck just above the pool edge, head to the right, thin tail to the left
dog.reference_point: cx,cy = centroid of full dark mask (incl. tail); body_cx,body_cy = centroid without tail

swim_ring.description: pink inflatable swim ring (torus) with a short tube/handle pointing into the hole toward the right; floating on the dark pool water, drifting left->right
swim_ring.reference_point: cx,cy = centre of ellipse fitted to outer contour (= torus centre)

size_px.note: bbox_w 144-145 px horizontal (x) vs 134 px vertical (y); max horizontal extent includes the shaded left rim

pool_edge.note: deck/water boundary, horizontal straight line across the frame (x 430..1920; left of 430 grass overhangs)

deck_coping_joint.note: horizontal joint ~20 px above pool edge

grass_bed.note: ornamental grass, left edge of frame

lounger_front_left.note: wooden sun lounger, backrest (top, y<250) raised

lounger_front_right.note: backrest at head end appears wider/skewed

lounger_back_row.note: three loungers cut off by the top frame edge

water.note: dark blue pool water, small ripples

events.dog: walking right at a nearly steady ~5.4 px/frame for the whole clip (frame 0-49); slight lateral sway cy 566-571 (gait); no start/stop inside the clip
events.swim_ring: drifts right; nearly at rest at start (~0.4 px/frame frames 0-1), speeds up (step rises ~1 px/frame per frame over frames 1-12, then more slowly) to a broad maximum ~11.5-12.1 px/frame over frames 20-29 (peak step 12.1 at frame 23, t=0.958 s), then slows smoothly to ~0.7 px/frame at frame 49; small up/down bob of cy (719.9..727.9 px); handle slowly rotates from ~17 deg to ~11 deg
events.no_contact: dog and ring never touch; ring stays in water, dog on deck
